Description.DefaultText: Hidden 0/1 marker: 1 once Guard Vane's cross-map seek duty reaches the player and calls in the Town Watch (Village_Master_Plan.md §10.8.11.2). Captain Sterling's Duty_SterlingRespondToSummon reads this and his own Encounter clears it back to 0 once it resolves. Distinct from cmcStatArrestPending, which self-clears the same tick it fires and cannot hold a durable state across a multi-hour walk.
